description: Fork of exp171 (val_bpb=1.7071, SOTA). Replace small unembedder with MLP: LayerNorm(384) → Linear(384, 3072, bias=False) → GELU → Linear(3072, vocab=32768, bias=False). Was: LN→Linear(384,vocab) (12.6M). New: 1.18M + 100.66M = 101.8M unembedder params. Δ +89M. Total ~424M. Tests if a richer LM head extracts more signal from the concat'd block outputs.
